win.clipboard.elevatedTarget: Can't type into an app running as administrator.
clipboard.localNote: Everything stays on this PC. Very large items are ignored.
clipboard.shortcutCaption: Opens a quick window with search, pinned items and Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 shortcuts for pasting into the previous app.
clipboard.shortcutHint: Click a card to paste it into the previous app. Ctrl-click selects several; Ctrl+C copies without pasting.
